**Finding submitted: deviation (MINCOMMIT).**

- **Issue:** Section 5(a) (p0045) obliges Client to pay "not less than $____ per month" for Hosting Services and Support Services — a minimum/take-or-pay floor on our party, with the amounts still blank. Section 6 (p0047) compounds this by excluding those minimum monthly fees from our documentation and charge-dispute rights.
- **Mitigants considered:** the term is one year with auto-renewal (p0078) and Client has a convenience termination right effective the last day of the month following notice (p0079) — close to the fallback, but the floor itself is still payable regardless of usage and is insulated from dispute.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** deleted the minimum-fee parenthetical, confirmed we pay only for services actually requested with no minimum purchase commitment, and removed the two consequential carve-outs in Section 6. Fallback (12-month floor, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty) offered in the comment.
